5. If Ivanna thinks practically, then Ivanna achieves success.

And we are told as fact:

So from (5) and (6) by modus tollens, Ivanna does not think practically.

But this contradicts the conclusion of Case B that she thinks practically.

Therefore the assumption that Ivanna is analytical must be false. Hence Ivanna is not analytical, so the statement "Ivanna is analytical" is false in this model. Therefore the context entails the negation of the conclusion, i.e., it entails that Ivanna is not analytical. Thus the conclusion "Ivanna is analytical" is not entailed; it is actually contradicted.
